headline: Ryanair Weighs Pay Freezes and Crew Cuts Amid Soaring Fuel Costs
summary: Ryanair is considering pay freezes, crew reductions, and increased use of AI as cost-cutting measures to offset soaring fuel costs driven by the Middle East conflict, risking clashes with unions.
why: Jet fuel is a major operating expense for airlines, meaning sharp price spikes can quickly erode profit margins across the sector.

impacts.name: Ryanair Holdings PLC
impacts.why: Cost-cutting measures aim to mitigate margin pressure from surging fuel expenses.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Surging fuel costs driven by geopolitical conflict threaten airline profitability, forcing management to consider defensive cost measures.
